g.text: Power retention, target matches and extra peaks

path.style: fill: none; stroke: #000000; stroke-width: 0.8; stroke-linejoin: miter; stroke-linecap: square

g.text: Eight measured candidates: area and scene tradeoffs
Power ratios use the 30-mic, N512, all-53-bin, eight-window reference. Matches pool three seeds; extra peaks are the median per scene, above −12 dB.
These are 2.2° localization diagnostics, not PD detections. FFT candidates use shorter N than DFT candidates: observation time and frequency resolution differ.
No field sensitivity, noise classifier, timing closure or continuous acquisition is established by these comparisons.
